title: Thread cover film on a 24 mm component feeder
instruction: Guide the cover film into the peel gears. Press and release the blue feed button three times to present three successive occupied pockets.
context: Load the carrier format used for 10 mm UFBGA controller components. The reference part is the STM32H753IIK6 used by the CUAV Pixhawk V6X v2.
setup: 24 mm carrier and three dummy packages at 16 mm pitch. Thin film leader on a separate guide. Side control starts 142 mm across from the tape centerline. Pick point is 22 mm along the feeder datum.
scoring: 0.25 for film travel instead of a loose leader. Each subsequent advance must be triggered independently and leave its occupied pocket within ±1 mm for 0.20 s. Full credit after all three, button released and final pocket in band for one second. Loss and stalls invalidate.
reset_notes: Return tape, film and feed button to zero, seat the packages in their starting pockets, and reset the index.
fidelity: Original bench fixture uses ST's 24 mm tape and 16 mm pocket pitch for 10 mm UFBGA parts. The rigid leader and static peel nip approximate flexible peeling. A physical button commands the simulated index actuator.
